milestones.name: Readiness
milestones.completion_contract: Hardware, quality targets, and local build toolchain are available.

milestones.name: Dual-camera transport Phase 0
milestones.completion_contract: An approved GO-WPD, GO-SEQUENTIAL, REVISE-TRANSPORT, or STOP decision is recorded with evidence.

milestones.name: Offline planar stitching PoC
milestones.completion_contract: Approved A0-class test fixture meets agreed geometry, color, seam, crop, and timing criteria.

milestones.name: Integrated MVP
milestones.completion_contract: One operation captures, pairs, preserves, stitches, and reports the result with safe failure handling.

milestones.name: Acceptance and packaging
milestones.completion_contract: Acceptance, durability, redistribution, installer, and release gates are approved.

work_items.title: Provision Windows build toolchain
work_items.verification: dotnet, CMake, and C++ compiler versions are recorded without installing licensed SDKs into the repo

work_items.title: Approve A0 quality and physical rig contract
work_items.verification: approved values are reflected in requirements and test plan

work_items.title: Build read-only WPD D750 capability probe
work_items.verification: two devices and supported commands/properties are listed with redacted aliases

work_items.title: Persist stable left/right camera identity
work_items.verification: connection order and USB port swap do not change assignment

work_items.title: Prove single-camera capture and JPEG transfer
work_items.verification: 10 consecutive captures or a reproducible unsupported-capability report

work_items.title: Prove dual-command and sequential transfer transaction
work_items.verification: 10 dual captures with zero mispairs

work_items.title: Run 100-cycle and reconnect stability test
work_items.verification: versioned redacted test report and logs

work_items.title: Approve camera transport decision
work_items.verification: one transport decision is approved and ADR-0005 is updated

work_items.title: Create rights-cleared A0 planar fixture and quality oracle
work_items.verification: fixture license, expected geometry, and thresholds are versioned

work_items.title: Implement rig calibration profile generator
work_items.verification: profile round-trip and calibration residual tests pass

work_items.title: Implement constrained planar stitch pipeline
work_items.verification: approved fixture produces deterministic output within thresholds

work_items.title: Add stitch quality metrics and rejection behavior
work_items.verification: good fixture passes and damaged/misaligned fixtures fail visibly

work_items.title: Create .NET 10 solution and domain contracts
work_items.verification: solution builds and domain tests pass

work_items.title: Implement isolated camera agents and IPC
work_items.verification: simulated and hardware agent lifecycle tests pass

work_items.title: Implement capture coordinator and durable transactions
work_items.verification: arrival-order, partial-failure, retry, and recovery tests pass

work_items.title: Implement WPF operator workflow
work_items.verification: operator walkthrough and accessible state/alert review

work_items.title: Integrate automatic stitch and restitch
work_items.verification: end-to-end fixture and hardware transaction tests pass

work_items.title: Run integrated MVP acceptance rehearsal
work_items.verification: evidence matrix covers every MVP requirement

work_items.title: Review licenses and redistributable dependencies
work_items.verification: approved dependency and redistribution inventory

work_items.title: Create installer and diagnostic bundle
work_items.verification: clean-PC install, smoke, uninstall, and log collection pass

work_items.title: Obtain MVP release decision
work_items.verification: product owner approves release candidate
